content:
Go to Sugar Grove and access the data center, located past the mainframe room that the key to the back of the building is found in. Use the U.S.S.A. access keycard to open the door. Talk with A.T.H.E.N.A. before Emerson and Sofia arrive. Either upload A.T.H.E.N.A. to Artemis or destroy her. After doing so, talk to Sofia and Emerson, and then return to the player character's C.A.M.P. to speak with Sofia once more to complete the quest and receive The V.A.T.S. Unknown, a unique Alien Blaster. If not already unlocked, this unlocks the Wish upon a Star achievement.

It's time to find and destroy this "ATHENA." Commander Daguerre believes it is located somewhere in Sugar Grove.

?

Talk to A.T.H.E.N.A.

?

Deal with A.T.H.E.N.A.

Time to confront A.T.H.E.N.A. I have the kill switch, which should be all I need to end this at long last.

?

(Optional) Upload A.T.H.E.N.A. into ARTEMIS

The A.T.H.E.N.A. unit has given me another option - I can transfer it into the ARTEMIS unit in this room... but it doesn't know if that will cure Sofia. The choice is up to me, I guess - transfer it or destroy it.

?

(Optional) Deploy Arachne

This is surprising. The A.T.H.E.N.A. wants me to use of the Arachne program to destroy it. It said I can use the terminal on the far wall to finally end this.

?

(Optional) Speak with Emerson

?

(Optional) Speak with Sofia

I used the Arachne program on A.T.H.E.N.A. Everything it was has been erased. I should talk to Sofia, see how she's doing with all this. OR I decided to give A.T.H.E.N.A. some autonomy by transferring it into an Assaultron body. I should check in with Sofia, see if it's helped at all with her headaches.

?

Speak with Commander Daguerre

?

Talk to Sofia back at C.A.M.P.

Now that this whole ordeal is over, I should talk with Sofia back at C.A.M.P.
